The '''Shadow AT-AT''' was an [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] covered with gleaming [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]]. Utilized by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought against the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the Shadow AT-AT was created solely for the purpose of intimidating enemy forces rather than performing stealth operations. The Alliance's [[Rebel trooper/Legends|soldiers]] found the Shadow AT-AT to be one of the most frightening specters on the battlefield.

==Characteristics==
An [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|142|Shadow AT-AT}}</ref> manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], the Shadow AT-AT was an assault [[Walker/Legends|walker]]<ref name="Titanium Series" /> covered with gleaming [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="CSWE" /> The Shadow AT-AT stood at an imposing height of 15.5 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], was armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], and was capable of carrying forty [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="Titanium Series" />

==Role==
The Shadow AT-AT was never intended to conduct stealth operations. Instead, it was created solely for intimidation,<ref name="CSWE" /> which the walker's black armor effectively helped to enhance. The Empire typically deployed the Shadow AT-AT during [[Standard day/Legends|night]] operations or on the dark surfaces of [[Star/Legends|sunless]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as a way of instilling terror into the minds of enemies. The Shadow AT-AT functioned as a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] and assault walker.<ref name="Titanium Series" />

==History==
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the Empire and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] utilized the Shadow AT-AT as a terror weapon. The sudden appearance of a massive Shadow AT-AT emerging out of the night with weapons blazing was among the most frightening things that the Alliance's [[Rebel trooper/Legends|troops]] faced.<ref name="Titanium Series" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow AT-AT was created for [[Hasbro]]'s [[2007]] ''[[Star Wars: Titanium Series]]'' line of die-cast figurine vehicles.<ref name="Titanium Series" />
